items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Look at all the old musicals, with Jimmy Cagney, remember he did “You’re a Grand Old Flag,” I’ve forgotten who was the writer.

ctx.x: How could he write such great harmonies?

I know, “White Christmas” and “I Lost the Sunshine,” he wrote all those pretty songs he did, a lot of nice things. But the songwriters did write all the good songs from way back. Look at all the old musicals, with Jimmy Cagney, remember he did “You’re a Grand Old Flag,” I’ve forgotten who was the writer.
